requirements.quote: Proposers are prohibited from contact related to this RFP with any Authority Board member, officer, staff, employee or representative other than designated personnel from the date this RFP is issued until the contract(s) have been executed by the Authority.
requirements.text: Proposers must not contact unauthorized personnel regarding the RFP.

requirements.quote: Violation of this provision is grounds for immediate disqualification.
requirements.text: Violating the communication restriction results in disqualification.

requirements.quote: All inquiries concerning this RFP must be done via email at: bids@syrairport.org
requirements.text: Inquiries must be sent via email to the specified address.

requirements.quote: Please indicate RFP Reference # 2023-20 in the subject line of the email.
requirements.text: Emails must include the RFP reference number in the subject line.
